children: Venture Global disclosed a new agreement for natural gas operator China Gas Holdings Limited to purchase 500,000 metric tons per annum of its U.S. liquefied natural gas for 20 years, starting in 2030.

The LNG producer said Monday that the agreement brings its current long-term offtake with China Gas to 2.5 metric tons per annum under 20-year sales and purchase agreements supplied across its portfolio.
Venture Global said the deal will help to supply China's growing energy needs with reliable, low-cost American LNG from across its Louisiana projects.
